Established language tasks at laptop scale, including nanoGPT training and phased inference, DistilBERT classification, NanoBEIR reranking, code generation, and structured function calling.

**Systems focus:** Attention and KV-cache mechanics, training-to-inference provenance, and the compute/memory regimes of transformer and structured-decoding phases.
